## The **technology** and **innovation** to simplify a complex world

Our differentiated solutions solve challenges all over the globe.

[READ MORE][28]

## Reliable, resilient
## **power** management
## for **data centers**

Data centers power the digital services we rely on every day. Learn how AMETEK solutions address the
**complex energy management** challenges that data center operators face.

[READ MORE][29]

## The** career opportunities** to let bold talent flourish

Our inclusive culture empowers our employees to perform at their best.

[READ MORE][30]

## De-risking **data centers**

**Real-time simulation** is reshaping how data centers manage risk across their power systems. Learn
how AMETEK is helping **data centers de‑risk power systems** and accelerate deployment.

[READ MORE][31]

### Every day, our technology makes a** safer**,
### **sustainable **and more **productive ** world a reality.

**We do it by bringing together and investing in passionate, talented people.**

##### **As a leading global provider **of differentiated electronic instruments and
##### electromechanical devices, we are proud to solve some of the world’s most complex challenges.
##### Our strength comes from **four key areas**.

#### OUR NICHE MARKET FOCUS

### A combined vision for success

We target niche markets aligned with secular growth trends that provide multiple avenues of growth.

#### OUR GROWTH MODEL

### Designed to excel

The AMETEK Growth Model integrates Operational Excellence, New Product Development, Global and
Market Expansion, and Strategic Acquisitions with a focus on cash flow generation and disciplined
capital deployment.

#### OUR PEOPLE AND CULTURE

### United by bright prospects

We have a strong performance-driven and decentralized culture made of diverse high-performance teams
located across the globe that execute our strategy and embrace our values by doing the right thing
every day, in every interaction.

#### OUR PERFORMANCE

### Proud to be out in front

Our culture is to outperform. Over the past 15, 10, and 5-year periods we have substantially
outperformed the S&P 500 index and the S&P Industrials. We deliver double-digit earnings over the
business cycle.

### **Explore** our products

##### **Life is full of complex challenges****.** Each one inspires us to do what we love. To make
##### the world a better place. Not just with our differentiated technologies that improve countless
##### lives, but by **empowering our people to inspire others** across the globe.

AMETEK CONSISTS OF TWO DIFFERENTIATED OPERATING GROUPS

## Our electronic instruments

AMETEK is a worldwide leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced analytical, test and
measurement instrumentation for the energy, aerospace, power, research, medical and industrial
markets.
BOTH OPERATING GROUPS OCCUPY LEADING POSITIONS IN NICHE MARKETS

## Our electromechanical devices

We are world-renowned as a differentiated supplier of automation and precision motion control
solutions, and highly engineered electrical interconnects, specialty metals and thermal management
systems.

### Learn more about **AMETEK**

#### Sustainability

### Building a culture of Continuous Improvement

[3D Measurement Products][107]

## Creaform Metrology Suite^{TM}

Proven, reliable 3D metrology software for real-world challenges
The Creaform Metrology Suite offers a comprehensive portfolio of application software modules
tailored for metrology applications, including product development, reverse engineering, inspection,
dynamic tracking, and digital twin generation.
[Metrology Software][108]

## FARO 3D Metrology Offering

FARO Technologies, Strengthening Leadership in 3D Metrology and Laser Projection Solutions
[Learn more about FARO Solutions][109]

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,
reliability and fast data acquisition.
[Ask for a live demo][110]

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

[3D Measurement Solutions][111]

## Creaform Metrology Suite^{TM}

Proven, reliable 3D metrology software for real-world challenges
The Creaform Metrology Suite offers a comprehensive portfolio of application software modules
tailored for metrology applications, including product development, reverse engineering, inspection,
dynamic tracking, and digital twin generation.
[Metrology Software][108]

## FARO 3D Metrology Offering

FARO Technologies, Strengthening Leadership in 3D Metrology and Laser Projection Solutions
[Learn more about FARO Solutions][109]

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,
reliability and fast data acquisition.
[Ask for a live demo][110]

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

# Nobody does
# adaptive
# like **Elekta**

Adaptive radiotherapy is changing what’s possible in cancer treatment.

Elekta is making it work in routine clinical practice, combining precision, workflow and evidence to
help centers deliver adaptive care as a new standard.

[Adaptive Radiotherapy][225]

Your browser does not support HTML video..

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

## Jetzt neu im ROTHENBERGER Bonusprogramm

Die Farben der Bonuspunkte einfach erklärt

**Rote Symbole: Punkte sammeln**
Rote Bonuspunkte-Symbole zeigen dir bei jedem bonusfähigen Werkzeug in Suche und Produktdetailseite
sofort, wie viele Punkte du beim Kauf erhältst.

**Weiße Symbole: Prämien einlösen**
Weiße Bonuspunkte-Symbole an den Prämien zeigen dir, wie viele Punkte du dafür brauchst – alle
passenden Prämien zu einem Produkt findest du im Reiter „Bonusprogramm“.

[Zum Bonusprogramm][13]
[
Energiegeladen in dein nächstes Projekt – hol dir unsere Maschinenpower!
Zu den AMPShare-Produkten
][14]

## Produktneuheiten für SHK-Profis

Wir bei ROTHENBERGER entwickeln, produzieren und vermarkten Rohrwerkzeuge und Maschinen für
Installateure, Heizungsbauer, Kälte-Klimatechniker und Servicemonteure. Unsere Geräte kommen auf
Baustellen im SHK-Gewerk und in Kälte-, Gas- und Umwelttechnik sowie in der Wartung zum Einsatz.

[Entdecke alle Neuprodukte][15]
[
ACR ProduktneuheitenMit unseren ACR Produktinnovationen bist du für Arbeiten an Kälte- und
Klimaanlagen bestens ausgerüstet. Evakuieren, Leckageortung, Montage und Messung sind alles kein
Problem.
][16]

Spiralen-Starterset 13 mmEnge Rohrführungen und Bögen sind kein Problem mehr – dank der neuen,
kompakten Rohrreinigungsspiralen.

Temperaturunterschiede.
][18]

ROMAX NANODie erste hybrid-Pressmaschine auf dem Markt, welche die intelligente NANO iJAW
Pressbacken-technologie und leistungsstarke Standard 32 kN Presskarft kombiniert.

darf auch der Akkubohrschrauber RO DD55 nicht fehlen.

# Industrial Borescope Cameras, Videoscopes & Inspection Systems


AIT provides advanced remote visual inspection equipment for aviation, manufacturing, power
generation, and industrial maintenance. Choose from articulating probes, high-resolution video
systems, and 3D measurement models designed to inspect hard-to-reach components with accuracy and
confidence.

[Explore Video Borescopes][104]
[Ultra small inspection solutions to fit inside the smallest spaces] [Ultra small inspection
solutions to fit inside the smallest spaces]

## Micro Borescopes & Fiberscopes for Small-Space Inspection

Inspect tight passages, small components, castings, tubes, and precision assemblies with ultra-thin
visual inspection probes. Our small-diameter systems help technicians access confined spaces while
maintaining clear imaging, control, and reliable documentation.

[Explore Micro Borescopes][105]
[Tank & vessel inspection cameras for extreme atmospheres] [Tank & vessel inspection cameras for
extreme atmospheres]

## Tank & vessel inspection cameras for extreme atmospheres

Inspect storage tanks, pressure vessels, reactors, and hazardous or confined environments with
purpose-built visual inspection systems. Our solutions help reduce entry risks, improve asset
assessment, and support safer maintenance planning.

[Explore Tank & Vessel Cameras][106]
[Pipe inspection solutions for any industrial application] [Pipe inspection solutions for any
industrial application]

## Pipe inspection solutions for any industrial application


Explore durable camera systems for pipelines, drains, ducts, and industrial process lines. From push
cameras to crawler-based inspection equipment, AIT helps teams locate issues, document conditions,
and plan maintenance with greater visibility.

[Push Cameras][107][Pipe Crawlers][108]

Imaging]

## Detect gas leaks 10x faster with acoustic Imaging

Detect compressed air leaks, gas leaks, vacuum issues, and partial discharge faster with acoustic
imaging technology. Visualize sound sources in real time to support energy savings, safety checks,
and predictive maintenance programs.

## ABOUT
## EN DE TEK
## AUSTRALIA

Since 1989, EN DE TEK Australia (formerly known as Krautkrämer Australia) has been a trusted
supplier of high-quality equipment to the Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) industry. Our commitment to
excellence is supported by our collaboration with leading manufacturers such as Baugh & Weedon,
Duerr-NDT, Dellon Borescopes, ETher NDE, Jiutai Technology RVI Pipe Crawlers, ENDETEK Borehole
Cameras, Krautkrämer (Waygate Technologies) Ultrasonics, LRM NDE Wire Rope Testers, DÜRR NDT GmbH &
Co. KG - CR & DR Xray Panels, Image Plates, Scanners, and D-TectX X-ray inspection software,
Screening Eagle Pte Ltd Swiss-based Hardness Testing.

 

Our Expertise

With decades of experience, we have developed a strong reputation for providing comprehensive
application solutions, advanced manufacturing, and unparalleled after-sales support. Our extensive
range of products and services is designed to meet the diverse needs of the NDT industry, ensuring
compliance with ISO standards.

 

Our Product Range

EN DE TEK Australia's product portfolio encompasses a wide array of Non-Destructive Testing methods,
including but not limited to:
* Ultrasonics: Cutting-edge ultrasonic testing equipment from Krautkrämer (Waygate Technologies)
  ensures precise and reliable inspections.
* Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL): Advanced MFL systems for detecting corrosion and pitting in various
  structures.
* Eddy Current: State-of-the-art eddy current testing devices from ETher NDE for surface and
  sub-surface flaw detection.
* Hardness Testing: Swiss-Made high-accuracy, excellent repeatability hardness testing instruments
  for different materials - using LEEB, Vickers and Rockwell Testing methods.
* Calibration/Test Blocks: Precision-manufactured calibration and test blocks for accurate NDT
  measurements.
* Remote Visual Inspection (RVI): Sophisticated RVI tools, including Dellon Borescopes and Jiutai
  Technology Pipe Crawlers, for thorough visual inspections.
* Computed & Digital Radiography: Comprehensive Film, CR & DR solutions from DÜRR NDT GmbH & Co. KG,
  including X-ray panels, image plates, scanners, and industry-leading D-TectX NDT X-Ray inspection
  software.

 

Our Mission

At EN DE TEK Australia, our mission is to provide the NDT industry with superior products and
solutions that ensure safety, reliability, and efficiency. We strive to exceed our customers'
expectations by offering innovative technologies, expert knowledge, and exceptional service.

 

Customer Support

Our commitment to customer satisfaction does not end with the sale. We offer robust after-sales
support, including technical assistance, product training, and maintenance services to ensure our
equipment performs optimally throughout its lifespan.

## ABOUT
## EN DE TEK
## AUSTRALIA

Since 1989, EN DE TEK Australia (formerly known as Krautkrämer Australia) has been a trusted
supplier of high-quality equipment to the Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) industry. Our commitment to
excellence is supported by our collaboration with leading manufacturers such as Baugh & Weedon,
Duerr-NDT, Dellon Borescopes, ETher NDE, Jiutai Technology RVI Pipe Crawlers, ENDETEK Borehole
Cameras, Krautkrämer (Waygate Technologies) Ultrasonics, LRM NDE Wire Rope Testers, DÜRR NDT GmbH &
Co. KG - CR & DR Xray Panels, Image Plates, Scanners, and D-TectX X-ray inspection software,
Screening Eagle Pte Ltd Swiss-based Hardness Testing.

 

Our Expertise

With decades of experience, we have developed a strong reputation for providing comprehensive
application solutions, advanced manufacturing, and unparalleled after-sales support. Our extensive
range of products and services is designed to meet the diverse needs of the NDT industry, ensuring
compliance with ISO standards.

 

Our Product Range

EN DE TEK Australia's product portfolio encompasses a wide array of Non-Destructive Testing methods,
including but not limited to:
* Ultrasonics: Cutting-edge ultrasonic testing equipment from Krautkrämer (Waygate Technologies)
  ensures precise and reliable inspections.
* Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL): Advanced MFL systems for detecting corrosion and pitting in various
  structures.
* Eddy Current: State-of-the-art eddy current testing devices from ETher NDE for surface and
  sub-surface flaw detection.
* Hardness Testing: Swiss-Made high-accuracy, excellent repeatability hardness testing instruments
  for different materials - using LEEB, Vickers and Rockwell Testing methods.
* Calibration/Test Blocks: Precision-manufactured calibration and test blocks for accurate NDT
  measurements.
* Remote Visual Inspection (RVI): Sophisticated RVI tools, including Dellon Borescopes and Jiutai
  Technology Pipe Crawlers, for thorough visual inspections.
* Computed & Digital Radiography: Comprehensive Film, CR & DR solutions from DÜRR NDT GmbH & Co. KG,
  including X-ray panels, image plates, scanners, and industry-leading D-TectX NDT X-Ray inspection
  software.

 

Our Mission

At EN DE TEK Australia, our mission is to provide the NDT industry with superior products and
solutions that ensure safety, reliability, and efficiency. We strive to exceed our customers'
expectations by offering innovative technologies, expert knowledge, and exceptional service.

 

Customer Support

Our commitment to customer satisfaction does not end with the sale. We offer robust after-sales
support, including technical assistance, product training, and maintenance services to ensure our
equipment performs optimally throughout its lifespan.

The HD Q2 Dual View Video Borescope offers the benefit of 2 Videoscopes for the price of one. With

#### **Hi-Resolution under 1mm diameter…**

At only .95mm in diameter the Hawkeye® Micro Q2 Video Borescope provides crisp, clear images. The
Micro Q2 Video Borescope has 8x better resolution than a fiberoptic borescope while having the
ability to capture still images and videos. The Micro Q2 is perfect for inspecting small diameter
medical devices, aerospace and automotive parts.

[View Micro Q2 Video Borescope][82]

[[Link to HD Video Borescopes]][84]

#### **Lightweight, Portable HD image quality…**

The new Hawkeye® Q2 HD Video Borescope has 6X the resolution of its predecessor the V2. With 4 way
joystick controlled articulation, a 4 hour battery and interchangeable insertion tubes, the Q2 is 
an outstanding value at an economical price. With diameters of 2.8, 3.9, and 6mm there is a Q2
Videoscope for almost every application.

[View Q2 HD Video Borescopes][85]

exposure weighting, and 90 degree and Close Focus tips. Aircraft and turbine engine inspection in

## [Dual View HD Video Borescopes][77]

[[Link to Dual View HD Video Borescopes]][78]

#### **HD Image with 0 and 90 degree cameras…**

The HD Q2 Dual View Video Borescope offers the benefit of 2 Videoscopes for the price of one. With
both 0 degree and 90 degree cameras, users can change between a forward view and a side view with
the press of a button. The Hawkeye® Q2 Dual View is perfect for engine and weld inspections as well
as automotive and aerospace parts.

[View Dual View Video Borescopes][79]

## [Micro Video Borescopes][80]

[[Link to Micro Video Borescopes]][81]

#### **Hi-Resolution under 1mm diameter…**

At only .95mm in diameter the Hawkeye® Micro Q2 Video Borescope provides crisp, clear images. The
Micro Q2 Video Borescope has 8x better resolution than a fiberoptic borescope while having the
ability to capture still images and videos. The Micro Q2 is perfect for inspecting small diameter
medical devices, aerospace and automotive parts.

[View Micro Q2 Video Borescope][82]

## [HD Video Borescopes][83]

[[Link to HD Video Borescopes]][84]

#### **Lightweight, Portable HD image quality…**

The new Hawkeye® Q2 HD Video Borescope has 6X the resolution of its predecessor the V2. With 4 way
joystick controlled articulation, a 4 hour battery and interchangeable insertion tubes, the Q2 is 
an outstanding value at an economical price. With diameters of 2.8, 3.9, and 6mm there is a Q2
Videoscope for almost every application.

[View Q2 HD Video Borescopes][85]

## [Servo HD Video Borescopes][86]

[[Link to Servo HD Video Borescopes]][87]

#### **Our Premier HD Video Borescope…**

The Hawkeye® V3 Video Borescope features a new Micro HD camera, 5.5″ touchscreen display,
servo-driven articulation, WiFi Streaming, Integrated Illumination, Anti-Glare, Center and Edge
exposure weighting, and 90 degree and Close Focus tips. Aircraft and turbine engine inspection in
particular, are perfectly suited for the V3.

[View V3 HD Video Borescope][88]

## [Rigid Borescopes][89]

[[Link to Rigid Borescopes]][90]

#### **When the entry path is straight…**

If you have a straight path, meaning that you do not have to go around any bends, then a rigid
borescope is almost always the best choice. Rigids have superior sharpness, durability, and are our
most cost-effective scopes. Our rigid borescopes can be connected to a camera, making it a low cost,
highly durable video borescope.

[View Rigid Borescopes][91]

## [Micro Flexible Borescopes][92]

[[Link to Micro Flexible Borescopes]][93]

#### **When you need small diameter…**

If you need to inspect small components the Hawkeye Micro Flexible Borescopes are the best solution.
With both video and fiber options we are confident our Borescopes will provide you with the highest
image quality in the world at a great value. Side view options available as small as 1.8mm for the
small orbital welds.

[View Micro Borescopes][94]

## [Video Borescopes][95]

[[Link to Video Borescopes]][96]

#### **Hi-Resolution, Full Screen inspections…**

Hawkeye® Video Borescopes simply deliver the best image quality of any borescope on the market
today! Hawkeye® Video Borescopes range from .9mm to 6mm and lengths up to 7.5 meters. Our innovative
technology like the Q2 Dual View Camera or Micro .9mm diameter are paving the way for industrial
visual inspection.

[View Video Borescopes][97]

## [Borescope Cameras][98]

[[Link to Borescope Cameras]][99]

#### **Borescope camera systems designed for you…**

Our experienced sales team works with you to create the right combination of borescopes, lighting,
camera and accessories to suit your specific inspection needs! The system may incorporate a video
monitor, innovative software or your own laptop/pc. Feel free to contact us about your application
to learn more.

[View Borescope Cameras][100]

[Your Eye Inside - The finest borescopes at the best prices - made in the USA]

## Featured Video

### Choosing a Borescope

With so many different borescopes available on the market, choosing the right scope can be
confusing. In this short video, GLC’s Chief Scientist explains each of the different types of
borescopes in order to help you choose the best quality, most cost-effective solution for your
application. [read more][101]

[View Full Video Library][102]

[View Full Video Library][103]

# Borescope Supplier & Manufacturer

Gradient Lens Corporation is a borescope supplier and manufacturer that provides cost-effective,
high-quality borescope equipment, perfect for your next inspection. Our Hawkeye precision borescopes
are carefully vetted and made from top-grade materials that are guaranteed to exceed your
expectations. We are the leading borescope supplier and manufacturer in the US, and we offer rigid,
flexible, and video-precision borescopes.

Whether you need a cost-effective rigid borescope that’s best for straight path casting or a
flexible fiberoptic borescope used by professionals working with curved paths regularly, we can
help. Our fully integrated portable video borescope is best used in complex casting and inspection
of critical parts found in air crafts, diesel and turbine engines, and more. As the number one
borescope supplier and manufacturer, we’re proud that our borescope equipment is made in the US and
delivered overnight. To find the right combination of borescopes, lighting, and accessories that
suit your specific inspection needs, call (800)-536-0790 today.

  **Strictly necessary cookies** are essential for providing the services available on our website

  **Tracking cookies** collect information about how visitors use our website—such as which pages

  cookies do not identify individual visitors.

  advertisements, but they may be less relevant.
  
  Active

  If you have any questions about our use of cookies or your choices, please contact us. For more

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

* What should I do if the lens of an industrial endoscope is blurred and stained?
  This may be caused by the lens is not clean or incomplete cleaning, you can try to clean the lens
  with detergent and soft cloth, if the effect is not good, you can choose to replace the lens or
  return to the factory for repair.
* Industrial endoscope guide inflexible how to solve?
  There may be various reasons for the inflexible steering of the probe of the industrial
  endoscope,Check the probe connection,Check the probe bearing,Check the probe hose,Check the
  controller,Lubricate the probe parts, If the above treatment methods are not effective, it is
  recommended to contact professional technicians for inspection and repair.
* What should be paid attention to when using industrial endoscope?
  Prohibit the use of industrial endoscope to observe the body or the animal's body;Do not use
  videoscope to inspect equipment in action; When finish using,please clean the tip of the
  videoscope probe in time, to prevent corrosion......

* What should I do if the lens of an industrial endoscope is blurred and stained?
  This may be caused by the lens is not clean or incomplete cleaning, you can try to clean the lens
  with detergent and soft cloth, if the effect is not good, you can choose to replace the lens or
  return to the factory for repair.
* Industrial endoscope guide inflexible how to solve?
  There may be various reasons for the inflexible steering of the probe of the industrial
  endoscope,Check the probe connection,Check the probe bearing,Check the probe hose,Check the
  controller,Lubricate the probe parts, If the above treatment methods are not effective, it is
  recommended to contact professional technicians for inspection and repair.
* What should be paid attention to when using industrial endoscope?
  Prohibit the use of industrial endoscope to observe the body or the animal's body;Do not use
  videoscope to inspect equipment in action; When finish using,please clean the tip of the
  videoscope probe in time, to prevent corrosion......

## Smart Optical Solutions for Reliable Industrial Quality Control

This homepage introduces a specialized range of optical and visual inspection technologies tailored
for demanding industrial environments.Designed to improve visual clarity, measurement precision, and
remote access diagnostics, these tools empower professionals across sectors to detect flaws,
validate tolerances, and maintain quality control with confidence.

The content includes descriptions of imaging and magnification systems, borescopes and endoscopes,
and high-accuracy surface inspection platforms.
Optical Visual Tech, a North America–focused B2B company based in Miami, FL, supports enterprises
with advanced visual systems that are built for reliability, durability, and performance. Known for
a customer-first approach, we offer ongoing product innovation, strict quality control, and expert
guidance.

Our mission is to help clients streamline inspections, reduce downtime, and unlock the full
potential of smart optical technologies in their operations. 

[ Connect with us ][45]

## Our Core Optical and Visual Inspection Tools

### Optical Measurement & Surface Inspection Systems

For customers seeking advanced metrology tools, our optical measurement and surface inspection
systems offer unmatched accuracy. Products include laser surface profilometers, vision measurement
systems, and non-contact dimensional scanners. These solutions help teams maintain tight tolerances,
verify material integrity, and document compliance to industry standards. Integrated with automated
reporting and intuitive interfaces, our systems from Optical Visual Tech are perfect for labs, R&D
centers, and precision manufacturing environments. 

[ Explore More ][46]

### Borescopes, Endoscopes & Visual Probes

Our range of flexible and rigid borescopes, fiber-optic endoscopes, and video probes allows
operators to inspect tight, confined, or inaccessible spaces without disassembly. Ideal for
aerospace, automotive, HVAC, and heavy equipment sectors, these tools capture high-resolution
internal visuals, aiding in preventative maintenance and troubleshooting. Many models include
articulation, adjustable lighting, and wireless connectivity. Optical Visual Tech helps clients
select the right inspection probe configuration to improve uptime and reduce inspection effort. 

[ Explore More ][47]

### Imaging & Magnification Tools

We provide a wide variety of industrial-grade imaging systems designed for high-resolution visual
analysis. From digital microscopes to handheld magnifiers with built-in displays, our tools enhance
visibility and precision during assembly, inspection, and failure analysis. These systems support
both real-time and recorded evaluations, ensuring defects and dimensional variations are identified
quickly and accurately. Designed for B2B settings where reliability is critical, Optical Visual Tech
delivers magnification solutions that fit seamlessly into quality assurance workflows.

## Smart Optical Solutions for Reliable Industrial Quality Control

This homepage introduces a specialized range of optical and visual inspection technologies tailored
for demanding industrial environments.Designed to improve visual clarity, measurement precision, and
remote access diagnostics, these tools empower professionals across sectors to detect flaws,
validate tolerances, and maintain quality control with confidence.

The content includes descriptions of imaging and magnification systems, borescopes and endoscopes,
and high-accuracy surface inspection platforms.
Optical Visual Tech, a North America–focused B2B company based in Miami, FL, supports enterprises
with advanced visual systems that are built for reliability, durability, and performance. Known for
a customer-first approach, we offer ongoing product innovation, strict quality control, and expert
guidance.

Our mission is to help clients streamline inspections, reduce downtime, and unlock the full
potential of smart optical technologies in their operations. 

[ Connect with us ][45]

## Our Core Optical and Visual Inspection Tools

### Optical Measurement & Surface Inspection Systems

For customers seeking advanced metrology tools, our optical measurement and surface inspection
systems offer unmatched accuracy. Products include laser surface profilometers, vision measurement
systems, and non-contact dimensional scanners. These solutions help teams maintain tight tolerances,
verify material integrity, and document compliance to industry standards. Integrated with automated
reporting and intuitive interfaces, our systems from Optical Visual Tech are perfect for labs, R&D
centers, and precision manufacturing environments. 

[ Explore More ][46]

### Borescopes, Endoscopes & Visual Probes

Our range of flexible and rigid borescopes, fiber-optic endoscopes, and video probes allows
operators to inspect tight, confined, or inaccessible spaces without disassembly. Ideal for
aerospace, automotive, HVAC, and heavy equipment sectors, these tools capture high-resolution
internal visuals, aiding in preventative maintenance and troubleshooting. Many models include
articulation, adjustable lighting, and wireless connectivity. Optical Visual Tech helps clients
select the right inspection probe configuration to improve uptime and reduce inspection effort. 

[ Explore More ][47]

### Imaging & Magnification Tools

We provide a wide variety of industrial-grade imaging systems designed for high-resolution visual
analysis. From digital microscopes to handheld magnifiers with built-in displays, our tools enhance
visibility and precision during assembly, inspection, and failure analysis. These systems support
both real-time and recorded evaluations, ensuring defects and dimensional variations are identified
quickly and accurately. Designed for B2B settings where reliability is critical, Optical Visual Tech
delivers magnification solutions that fit seamlessly into quality assurance workflows.

Orbital Welding Systems & Special Purpose Machines. We offer totally indigenously manufactured
Closed Head Orbital welding system machines to our wide spread customers all over the world. We are
one of the company helping our customers to increase their performance giving full and thorough
advice in the complete process. We understand the demand for today's growing industry and we promise
to meet the various needs of the industry. We have a veteran staff capable of servicing all types of
machines.

## Penn Tool Co. Industrial Supply

Penn Tool Co., Inc. is a family owned and operated industrial supplier that serves the metalworking
community, the General Services Administration (GSA), and other government purchasing resources.

Penn Tool had humble beginnings as a small hardware store near Newark Penn Station, but would go on
to transition into a specialty precision measuring instruments supplier. Our company empowers
manufacturers, and other commercial applications, to maximize productivity, efficiency, and
profitability.

We strive to provide high-quality products and superior customer service to professionals in a
diverse range of industries — and have been doing so for over 50 years.

About us

## Penn Tool Co. Industrial Supply

Penn Tool Co., Inc. is a family owned and operated industrial supplier that serves the metalworking
community, the General Services Administration (GSA), and other government purchasing resources.

Penn Tool had humble beginnings as a small hardware store near Newark Penn Station, but would go on
to transition into a specialty precision measuring instruments supplier. Our company empowers
manufacturers, and other commercial applications, to maximize productivity, efficiency, and
profitability.

We strive to provide high-quality products and superior customer service to professionals in a
diverse range of industries — and have been doing so for over 50 years.

## What Our Trusted Clients Say

##### Hats off to the hard working crew

I had a hot water leak under the foundation in my kitchen. It was apparent a complete hot/cold water
re-piping was the only answer. My hat’s off to the hard-working crew who accomplished the work in
three days time. They informed me of each step of the process, checked to make sure I was being
accommodated as much as possible during the disruption, and cleaned up the debris when all was done.
The bid for the work was reasonable, and all the lines are working fine now. No more scary leak. I
was a customer in the very early days of the company, and I plan to continue with then.

Sandra Fittinghoff

##### Wonderful service and prompt

Wonderful service George was prompt courteous, and got the job done..


Taxtrimmer

##### All I can say is they are the most professional, timely, hardworking crew

Woke up to my only toilet leaking, these guys came out within 2 hours and got the job done. Not the
cheapest option but they were fast, professional, and did a good job.


Jack D. Reno, NV

##### I would not hesitate to recommend Plumbing Doctor to others

Professionalism, Punctuality, Quality, Responsiveness I’ve used Plumbing Doctor twice now and both
times they provided excellent service. The people who answer the phone are very nice, keep you
informed about schedule, and will call you if they can get to your job earlier then originally
scheduled. Both of the techs who came to my house were very nice, polite, and knowledgeable. They
clearly explained the job and costs ahead of time, and seemed happy to explain what they were doing
while making the repairs. I didn’t check the “good value” box because I didn’t hunt around for other
estimates so I don’t know how Plumbing Doctor costs compare to other plumbers. That said, I think
they are a good value because the job was done well and hassle free. I would not hesitate to
recommend Plumbing Doctor to others.


Sandra Perry

##### Mason was always professional, arrived on time, and worked hard to make sure the issues we
##### were experiencing got resolved.

We recently moved into an older home and were experiencing plumbing issues from the start. We
ultimately had to undergo a big project to replace the piping throughout the home and we are really
happy that we got to work with this company, and specifically Mason. Mason was always professional,
arrived on time, and worked hard to make sure the issues we were experiencing got resolved. Mason
always took the extra time to explain the work being done and we learned a lot about our home in the
process. We would definitely recommend the Plumbing Doctor and are thankful we got work with Mason
and the team.

John Coulter

##### They are always great.

I’ve used them for years. They are always great. I’m in their customer care program too. I’m very
glad they’re around. It means plumbing is one thing I never have to worry about.


Diane Moore

landlords, investors, and insurance clients — no matter where they are.

can’t, don’t have time, or have too many properties to manage.

valid, reliable documentation of your property.

## Peace of Mind from Anywhere

Whether you're abroad or busy, we give you a trusted way to stay informed and protected — without
being physically present.

## Property Insurance Starts with Visual Proof

At REVIS, we believe that seeing is securing!  Get high-quality, detailed, time stamped video
inspections of your property to document its condition, contents, and structure before disaster
strikes.  **Considering the recent Southern California fires, this would be an invaluable resource
in insurance reimbursement and rebuilding.**  Our professionally recorded walk-throughs provide
trusted visual proof for your personal protection.  Whether you’re preparing for insurance coverage,
renewing a policy, or protecting against future loss, our services support faster, stronger
insurance claims and help reduce disputes, which will give you peace of mind and protection when it
matters most.

## Our Inspections Include

Have questions about our video inspection services? Explore answers to the most common queries about
process, pricing, delivery, and how we support your insurance needs.
* Walk-through coverage of all rooms (bedrooms, kitchen, etc.)
* Focused shots on expensive or insured items
* Exterior visuals of the building, garage, gates, fences, outside property, etc.
* Security points such as locks, doors, windows, cameras
* For businesses, all rooms and equipment throughout the property (office suites, factory
  floors,etc)

## Our Work

## See Our Inspections in Action

Watch real examples of our home insurance video inspections and discover how we document every
detail with clarity, professionalism, and purpose — before and after damage occurs.

## 10 Marla Modern Home

This video showcases a modern, single-story home with a complete walk-through of both the interior
and exterior. The recording highlights furniture, appliances, and fixtures in detail, creating a
strong visual record of the property. In case of an insurance claim, this footage serves as clear
proof of the home’s condition and contents at the time of coverage.

[ Contact Now ][21]

## 10 Marla Designer House

This video focuses on a dedicated work or tech room, capturing multiple laptops, desktop PCs,
chairs, and other valuable electronic equipment. The recording clearly shows the arrangement and
condition of each item, ensuring every asset is visually documented. This serves as solid proof for
insurance purposes, helping verify ownership and the presence of high-value items in case of theft,
fire, or damage.

[ Contact Now ][22]

## Luxury Villa

This inspection features a single-family residence and captures both the indoor areas. and outdoor
spaces, such asthe garden, garage, fencing, and external fixtures. The comprehensive visual coverage
ensures the entire property is documented, giving the homeowner confidence that all assets are
protected and easily verifiable during an insurance claim.

[ Contact Now ][23]
[ See More ][24]

## Our rates are extremely reasonable
* For single-family homes, the price is $295 for up to a 1500 square-foot home (this does include
  detached town homes), which does include the exterior but not the roof. Attached garages are
  included, but detached garages, pool houses or any other detached structures will be extra,
  depending upon how many structures and the square footage.  Each additional increment up to 500
  square feet will be an additional $50.  For example, an 1800 square-foot home with a detached
  garage would be $370, which includes the $50 extra square-footage charge and $25 extra for the
  garage.
* For apartments 1200 square feet and less, we charge $195, interior only, but will include
  balconies. Garages will be $25 extra.  Each additional increment up to 500 square feet will be an
  additional $50.  For example, a 1600 square-foot unit would be $245.  If it had a detached garage,
  it would be $270.
* Video shipping rate: Those who want a flash drive can request 2-day delivery nationally for an
  additional $30. We will store all videos for 30 days.

## FAQS

## Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions about our video inspection services? Explore answers to the most common queries about
process, pricing, delivery, and how we support your insurance needs.

What is a home insurance video inspection?

A home insurance video inspection is a professionally recorded video walk-through of your property
that documents its current condition and contents. It serves as visual proof in case of fire, theft,
or other damage, helping you support insurance claims more effectively.

How can these videos help with my insurance claim?

Our videos provide clear, Time stamped documentation of your home and belongings. This helps verify
your claim, reduces disputes, and speeds up the approval process with your insurance provider.

Do I need to be present during the inspection?

No, you don’t need to be present. Our team can handle the entire process with your permission,
making it easy for overseas or busy homeowners.

What areas of my property are covered in the inspection?

We cover all key areas of your home including bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, living spaces, exterior
views, and close-ups of valuable items like electronics and appliances.

Can the inspection be customized to my insurance company’s requirements?

Yes, absolutely. We offer custom walk-throughs based on your insurer’s checklist or specific needs —
ensuring your video meets all required standards

## Testimonials

## What Our Clients Say

Our clients trust us for clear, reliable video inspections — and their words speak for themselves.
Here’s what they have to say about their experience with REVIS.

I live abroad. REVIS provided a clear, detailed inspection video. Made remote management easy.

**James Carter** Real Estate Buyer

Great experience with REVIS! Their clear inspection video and support gave me peace of mind while

**Daniel Nguyen** Real Estate Investor

[
[Utility Locating]

## [][135]

Mark the location and depth of underground utilities or other potential anomalies.

[
[Concrete Imaging]
][137]

## [][138]
## [Concrete Imaging][139]

Determine the location and depth of potential obstructions embedded within concrete.

[
[Leak Detection]
][140]

## [][141]
## [Leak Detection][142]

Find and pinpoint the location of water leaks in underground potable water lines.

[
[Video Inspection]
][143]

## [][144]
## [Video Inspection][145]

Inspect the insides of pipes to search for breaks, blockages or other problems.

[
][146]

## [][147]
## [History][148]

Underground Surveying was founded in 2005 by Peter Viola and Kamal Abdulrazak, in response to the
growing need for private utility locating services in Connecticut and New York.

[

Learn More

][149]
[
][150]

## [][151]
## [Purpose][152]

Our primary goal of doing business is to help our clients reduce risk, gain peace of mind, and keep
their projects running on schedule by providing them with fast, thorough, and accurate subsurface
imaging services.

[

Learn More

][153]
[
][154]

## [][155]
## [Qualifications][156]

All newly hired geophysical survey technicians must work alongside an experienced project manager
for at least 1 year, before finally being given permission to work on their own projects without
supervision.

### Precision Inspection Systems Trusted by Industry Leaders

Zibra Corporation engineers industrial borescopes and videoscopes for precision inspections across
industries worldwide. With over 40 years of expertise, we deliver innovative lighting systems and
custom imaging solutions trusted by professionals.

## Scopes

Zibra Corp designs and manufactures precision borescope solutions in Massachusetts, offering rigid,
semi-rigid, flexible, and articulating micro borescopes, fiberscopes, and videoscopes for industrial
and medical-grade inspections. Whether you’re performing close-range ID inspections or navigating
complex passages, our engineers will guide you in selecting or customizing the right scope for your
application.

With modular systems built to withstand harsh environments and tight tolerances, we serve inspection
professionals across aerospace, manufacturing, energy, and healthcare industries. Explore our full
range of small diameter video borescopes, high-resolution fiber optic scopes, and durable custom
assemblies.

## Video

Zibra Corp stocks a complete line of industrial-grade videoscope cameras, video monitors, and
borescope video accessories, all engineered to deliver exceptional performance in demanding
inspection environments. Designed and assembled in Massachusetts, our high-definition and analog
video components integrate seamlessly with Zibra’s borescope systems, ensuring sharp visualization
and reliable signal transmission. From real-time image capture to live display and digital
recording, our video equipment supports efficient workflows across aerospace, manufacturing, and
medical fields. Choose from USB-enabled c-mount cameras, ViewZ monitors, and DIN-to-C-mount couplers
to build your ideal visual inspection setup.

## Lighting

Zibra Corp offers a complete selection of LED borescope light sources, including compact handheld
units and high-performance benchtop systems built for industrial and medical inspection
environments. Our borescope lighting solutions deliver consistent, high-intensity illumination with
minimal maintenance. Whether you’re conducting remote visual inspection in the field or under
controlled lab conditions, our lighting equipment ensures optimal visibility across all Zibra scope
systems. Explore options like the ZC-LED50 and battery-powered portable models for precision
lighting in tight or hard-to-reach areas.

## Custom Solutions

When standard scopes can’t reach or resolve the problem, Zibra Corp builds custom visual inspection
solutions from the ground up. Our engineering team collaborates with customers to design
micro-optical assemblies, shaped probes, specialty illumination setups, and high-magnification tools
tailored to unique environments. From complex medical devices to advanced aerospace components, we
solve challenges that off-the-shelf scopes can’t. Every custom solution is designed, prototyped, and
supported in-house.

### Close Fitting Inner Diameter (ID) Inspection

Zibra Corp’s Close Fitting Inner Diameter Inspection solutions are engineered to deliver precise,
reliable imaging in confined internal spaces. By optimizing optics, illumination, and viewing
angles, we ensure clear visualization of polished, welded, or machined surfaces. Our custom
configurations provide accurate, efficient results for demanding ID inspection applications.

[Learn More →][124]
[Close-fitting scope for ID inspection]

### Intersecting Passages

Zibra Corp provides custom solutions for intersecting passage inspections that require precise
lighting and directional control. Using techniques such as mirror tubes for 90° views or flexible
scopes for angled entries, our systems deliver clear visualization in hard-to-reach intersections.
Whether using standard or custom configurations, we ensure accurate and efficient results for
complex inspection needs.

[Learn More →][125]
[Intersecting passages]

### Large Cavities with Multiple Object Distances

Zibra Corp provides custom inspection solutions for large cavities where multiple object distances
must be evaluated. Our approach combines precise lighting, specialized scope designs, and strategic
access planning to deliver clear, reliable imaging. Whether the application calls for rigid,
semi-rigid, or custom probes, our systems are built to handle the most complex large cavity
inspections.

[Learn More →][126]
[Large cavities]

### Orbital Welds in Pipings

Zibra Corp delivers tailored inspection solutions for orbital welds in sanitary and high-purity
piping. Our flexible fiberscopes navigate sharp bends and allow full circumferential weld
inspection, even in restricted access conditions. Available in a range of diameters, these solutions
provide consistent results for piping from 1/4 inch to 4 inches in diameter.

[Learn More →][127]
[Orbital welds]

### Very Close Focus

Zibra Corp designs custom inspection scopes for applications requiring extremely close focus. Our
in-house lens design capabilities allow us to configure scopes for working distances as short as 0–3
mm. With precise optics, careful illumination design, and tailored specifications, we deliver clear,
reliable imaging for specialized close range inspections.

[Learn More →][128]
[Close focus]

### Infrared Applications (IR)

Zibra Corp offers custom solutions for inspection applications using infrared illumination. Our team
evaluates camera, lighting, and fiber configurations to maximize IR performance while protecting
scope components. From specialized lighting adjustments to fiber bundle selection, we ensure
reliable imaging in environments where infrared inspection is required.

[Learn More →][129]
[Infrared imaging]

### Ultraviolet (UV) Illumination Applications

Zibra Corp provides custom solutions for inspection applications using ultraviolet illumination. Our
scopes and lighting systems are configured to maximize UV transmission for precise, reliable
results. Whether for non-destructive testing, contamination detection, or specialized surface
analysis, we deliver clear, consistent imaging with UV-compatible configurations.

[Learn More →][130]
[Ultraviolet illumination]

## Scopes

Zibra Corp designs and manufactures precision borescope solutions in Massachusetts, offering rigid,
semi-rigid, flexible, and articulating micro borescopes, fiberscopes, and videoscopes for industrial
and medical-grade inspections. Whether you’re performing close-range ID inspections or navigating
complex passages, our engineers will guide you in selecting or customizing the right scope for your
application.

With modular systems built to withstand harsh environments and tight tolerances, we serve inspection
professionals across aerospace, manufacturing, energy, and healthcare industries. Explore our full
range of small diameter video borescopes, high-resolution fiber optic scopes, and durable custom
assemblies.

Zibra Corp stocks a complete line of industrial-grade videoscope cameras, video monitors, and
borescope video accessories, all engineered to deliver exceptional performance in demanding
inspection environments. Designed and assembled in Massachusetts, our high-definition and analog
video components integrate seamlessly with Zibra’s borescope systems, ensuring sharp visualization
and reliable signal transmission. From real-time image capture to live display and digital
recording, our video equipment supports efficient workflows across aerospace, manufacturing, and
medical fields. Choose from USB-enabled c-mount cameras, ViewZ monitors, and DIN-to-C-mount couplers
to build your ideal visual inspection setup.

minimal maintenance. Whether you’re conducting remote visual inspection in the field or under
controlled lab conditions, our lighting equipment ensures optimal visibility across all Zibra scope
systems. Explore options like the ZC-LED50 and battery-powered portable models for precision

### Close Fitting Inner Diameter (ID) Inspection

Zibra Corp’s Close Fitting Inner Diameter Inspection solutions are engineered to deliver precise,
reliable imaging in confined internal spaces. By optimizing optics, illumination, and viewing
angles, we ensure clear visualization of polished, welded, or machined surfaces. Our custom
configurations provide accurate, efficient results for demanding ID inspection applications.

### Intersecting Passages

Zibra Corp provides custom solutions for intersecting passage inspections that require precise
lighting and directional control. Using techniques such as mirror tubes for 90° views or flexible
scopes for angled entries, our systems deliver clear visualization in hard-to-reach intersections.
Whether using standard or custom configurations, we ensure accurate and efficient results for
complex inspection needs.

[Learn More →][125]
[Intersecting passages]

### Large Cavities with Multiple Object Distances

Zibra Corp provides custom inspection solutions for large cavities where multiple object distances
must be evaluated. Our approach combines precise lighting, specialized scope designs, and strategic
access planning to deliver clear, reliable imaging. Whether the application calls for rigid,
semi-rigid, or custom probes, our systems are built to handle the most complex large cavity
inspections.

[Learn More →][126]
[Large cavities]

### Orbital Welds in Pipings

Zibra Corp delivers tailored inspection solutions for orbital welds in sanitary and high-purity
piping. Our flexible fiberscopes navigate sharp bends and allow full circumferential weld
inspection, even in restricted access conditions. Available in a range of diameters, these solutions
provide consistent results for piping from 1/4 inch to 4 inches in diameter.

[Learn More →][127]

### Very Close Focus

Zibra Corp designs custom inspection scopes for applications requiring extremely close focus. Our
in-house lens design capabilities allow us to configure scopes for working distances as short as 0–3
mm. With precise optics, careful illumination design, and tailored specifications, we deliver clear,
reliable imaging for specialized close range inspections.

[Learn More →][128]

### Infrared Applications (IR)

Zibra Corp offers custom solutions for inspection applications using infrared illumination. Our team
evaluates camera, lighting, and fiber configurations to maximize IR performance while protecting
scope components. From specialized lighting adjustments to fiber bundle selection, we ensure
reliable imaging in environments where infrared inspection is required.
